verdict.rationale: Paystack's docs describe a separate test environment, selected by test API keys, that uses the same API as live, so the core sandbox and test mode is documented. Nothing in the pack covers test cards or simulating declines and disputes. Missing for 10: documented test card numbers, decline-scenario simulation, dispute/chargeback simulation, and independent or hands-on corroboration that test mode mirrors production.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and test the entire payment flow in a sandbox or test mode that mirrors production, with test cards for every scenario including declines and disputes

citations.quote: Use your test keys for development and testing, and your live keys for production.
This works for both test and live environments. Your API keys determine which environment you're using.
